name: Stanley Anderson
original_name: スタンリー＝アンダーソン
source:
A popular writer in the world who won the "Nopel Literary Award". It is called "Prince of the Black Rose" from the title of his hit novel.
A descendant of a British aristocrat with a noble belief who received the title of "Sir" from Her Majesty the Queen.
Each of Stanley's words, like a literary master, grabs everyone's heart.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/stanley_anderson.html]official website[/url]]
